programs.delivery: FORCE: anti-TfR1 Fab conjugated to PMO, IV
programs.stage: Preclinical / IND-enabling; in vitro exon 55 skipping shown at NMSG, Sept 25-27 2026
programs.key_result: In vitro exon 55 skipping with Fab-PMO; one of four DMD candidates (exons 44/45/53/55) moving into IND-enabling studies on the same platform as z-rostudirsen
programs.changes_decision_because: Exon-55 PMO sequence and muscle delivery already exist; partner or license rather than rebuild.

programs.delivery: FORCE anti-TfR1 Fab-PMO, 20 mg/kg Q4W IV
programs.stage: BLA accepted, Priority Review, accelerated approval; PDUFA Jan 21 2027; Phase 3 FORZETTO ongoing
programs.key_result: Mean 8.72% of normal dystrophin (muscle-adjusted) at 6 months, 20 mg/kg Q4W; sustained functional improvement through 18 months in DELIVER
programs.changes_decision_because: Validates TfR1-Fab-PMO exposure and dosing; potency is exon-51-specific, not an exon-55 expectation.

programs.target: Permanent genomic excision of DMD exons 45-55 (includes exon 55 mutations)
programs.delivery: Single AAV carrying two complementary ARCUS nucleases, one-time IV
programs.stage: Phase 1/2a NCT07429240, dosing commenced 2026, ambulatory patients ages 2-7, completion Dec 2029
programs.key_result: Preclinical durable dystrophin and functional benefit (MDA 2025, MDA 2026); IND cleared; first sites activated and first patients dosed 2026
programs.changes_decision_because: Only program recruiting our exact genotype class; one-time dosing competes with chronic ASO.

programs.target: Ribosomal readthrough of premature termination codons - the same lesion class as exon 55 nonsense
programs.stage: DISCONTINUED/FAILED: EC declined renewal of EU marketing authorisation (April 2025); US NDA resubmission withdrawn Feb 12 2026 after FDA said data unlikely to meet substantial-evidence threshold
programs.key_result: Regulators in both regions concluded effectiveness was not established
programs.changes_decision_because: Nonsense-mutation DMD now has no mechanism-matched drug; skipping is the only route, no comparator.

programs.target: DMD exon 44 skipping using two linked PMO sequences against two splicing-regulator sites in one exon
programs.stage: Phase 1/2 plus extension; 5-year data presented WMS Hiroshima Sept 29-Oct 3 2026; FDA Breakthrough and Orphan designations; global Phase 2 via NS Pharma
programs.key_result: Motor function improved or maintained in ambulant patients, upper-limb function maintained in those who lost ambulation; no serious related AEs, no discontinuations over 5 years
programs.changes_decision_because: Clinical and regulatory precedent for a multi-sequence oligo as one product - supports a 54+55 construct.

programs.organization: Avidity Biosciences (acquired by Novartis, closed Feb 27 2026)
programs.delivery: AOC: anti-TfR1 monoclonal antibody-PMO conjugate, IV Q6W
programs.stage: BLA submitted June 25 2026, accepted for Priority Review Sept 2026 under accelerated approval; Phase 3 SAFARI44 confirmatory; US managed access program
programs.key_result: Statistically significant ~25% increase in dystrophin production; reversal of disease progression across functional endpoints in EXPLORE44 and EXPLORE44-OLE
programs.changes_decision_because: TfR1 antibody route is near-approval, but Novartis ownership removes Avidity as an independent partner.

programs.target: DMD exon 44 skipping; exon 45, 50, 51 candidates reporting in 2026
programs.delivery: Endosomal Escape Vehicle (EEV) cyclic-peptide-conjugated PMO, IV
programs.stage: Phase 1/2 ELEVATE-44-201 Cohort 1 topline May 2026; Cohort 2 and OLE data expected by end 2026; ENTR-601-45 MAD Cohort 1 data mid-2026; prior FDA clinical hold since lifted
programs.key_result: Met primary safety objective; +2.36% dystrophin over 4.00% baseline and +2.31% exon skipping over 2.66% baseline; Time-to-Rise velocity difference vs placebo 0.115 (p<0.05, post hoc)
programs.changes_decision_because: Non-receptor-antibody delivery alternative, but modest absolute dystrophin tempers EEV exposure assumptions.

programs.delivery: Unconjugated stereopure PN-backbone ASO, monthly IV
programs.stage: Phase 2 FORWARD-53 48-week data (MDA, March 8-11 2026); NDA for accelerated approval planned 2026
programs.key_result: Sustained exon skipping, muscle concentration and dystrophin restoration through 48 weeks; 61-day tissue half-life supporting monthly dosing; functional benefit and reversal of muscle damage markers; no serious AEs
programs.changes_decision_because: Backbone chemistry alone can reach muscle - avoids doubling conjugate CMC for a two-oligo cocktail.

programs.stage: Phase 3 confirmatory completed; primary endpoint missed; FDA action date Feb 28 2027 on conversion to traditional approval
programs.key_result: 4-step ascend velocity difference 0.06 steps/sec, p=0.309 (miss); dystrophin by western blot and IHC fiber intensity significant at week 96; safety favorable
programs.changes_decision_because: Dystrophin-biomarker accelerated approval is under active FDA scrutiny; plan a functional confirmatory endpoint early.

programs.program: SRP-5051 (vesleteplirsen) - discontinued; plus July 2025 pipeline restructuring
programs.delivery: Cell-penetrating cationic peptide-conjugated PMO (PPMO), monthly IV
programs.stage: DISCONTINUED Nov 2024 on benefit-risk; Sarepta restructuring (July 2025) cut ~500 roles, retains only the three marketed PMOs and pivots new work to siRNA
programs.key_result: Persistent hypomagnesemia and declining renal function; prior FDA clinical hold; development stopped despite higher skipping than eteplirsen
programs.changes_decision_because: Cationic peptide-PMO carries renal/electrolyte liability; the largest PMO incumbent exited new ASO development.

programs.target: DMD exon 51 (lead 000A-L8c) and exon 45; no data on exons 54, 55 or 56
programs.delivery: MOE/PS, OMe/PS and PMO chemistries, unconjugated systemic
programs.stage: Preclinical: humanized mouse and cynomolgus monkey
programs.key_result: ~90% exon 51 skipping in skeletal muscle; 3 mg/kg comparable to eteplirsen at 100 mg/kg (~30-fold potency gain); dystrophin restoration, improved grip strength, reduced CK
programs.changes_decision_because: Potency lever that could rescue a weak exon-54/55 oligo pair; untested on this exon block.

programs.program: PALM-SQY16 and its rare-mutation ASO selection scheme
programs.target: DMD exon 16 skipping - an ultra-rare, non-hotspot exon; explicit template for n-of-1
programs.stage: Preclinical, published Aug 3 2026 (PMID 42662226); framed for compassionate use and n=1 trials
programs.key_result: 59 candidates screened to one lead; up to 50% exon 16 skipping and ~47% of wild-type dystrophin in 3D human muscle tissue; safety counter-screens for dimerization, coagulation and complement across species
programs.changes_decision_because: Reusable screening cascade and chemistry for an ultra-rare lesion with an explicit n-of-1 regulatory path.

programs.program: Mutation-tailored PMO cocktails for exons 45-55 multi-exon skipping
programs.target: Contiguous multi-exon skipping across the 45-55 block, including exon 55
programs.delivery: Naked PMO cocktails in vitro and in mdx52 mice; no conjugate, no clinical program
programs.stage: Preclinical only; no IND or trial found as of Oct 2026
programs.key_result: Cocktails induced removal of 3, 8 or 10 exons with dystrophin restoration in patient-derived transdifferentiated myotubes; bodywide 45-55 skipping in mdx52; del45-55 patients are exceptionally mild or asymptomatic
programs.changes_decision_because: Only multi-exon-skipping evidence for this block; proves cocktails work but shows no clinical sponsor.
